name: lamp
what: The leaf of the backlit material card: Fargoh's yellow leaf on a lamp (Commons 'Ginkgo biloba yellow leaf on a lamp', CC BY-SA 4.0; ref/yinxing/commons/), its outline traced, its veins grown by the rule (not traced: the photo's veins are the check).

flank_depth_mm.source: the margin deeper than this below the convex hull is a notch's or an incision's flank, which veins run along; shallower dips (the margin's waves, 1-3 mm) are ended on as on the rest of the distal margin [A]

split_spacing_mm.source: fitted so the spacing 1-8 mm inside the distal margin comes out at Leigh et al. 2011's 0.67-0.70 mm (short shoots, Table 1) [F]

split_sd.source: the forks' spread in position: the photos show forks at all distances from the base [A]

branch_half_angle_deg.source: half of 22 +- 2 degrees, the dichotomy's angle as Carvalho, Losada & Niklas 2018 (Curr. Opin. Plant Biol. 43:29, p. 30) cite it; the original measurement not checked [I]

steer_max_angle_deg.source: how far off the flow line a vein turns to even out its spacing [A]; at the dichotomy's 11 degrees the veins near the axis of a notched leaf could not keep up with the fan's opening and left a bare strip (objects/yinxing/notched.json)

relax_mm.source: the distance over which a vein evens out its spacing [A]

edge_offset_mm.source: the outermost vein's distance inside a lateral margin [A, the photos: a vein runs along the lateral margins]

wander.source: the veins' small lateral wandering (slope noise per step) [A]

start_mm.source: numerical: the bundles start this far above the base [A]

min_fork_mm.source: a vein forks again only after running this far from its own fork [A]; without it a vein far from a wall can fork at every step (the notched leaf did)

marginal_max_angle_deg.source: the outermost veins hug the lateral margins (the photos: a vein runs along each); they may turn this far off the flow line to stay on them [A]

width_tip_mm.source: the vein column's width at the margin, between the bundle-sheath extensions' width at the margin (Leigh 2011 Table 1: 7563 um2 over the 163 um lamina, about 46 um) and Baresch et al. 2019's 136 um traced width [A]

width_exponent.source: widths w_tip * n^e: Leigh 2011's bundle-sheath-extension area base over margin 20957/7563 = 2.77 over the thickness ratio 278/163 = 1.71 gives a width ratio 1.62 between the blade's base (about 20 endings downstream, [A]) and the margin (one): e = ln 1.62 / ln 20 [D/A]

surface.source: the card's leaf lies flat on the lamp [A]

length_mm.source: Klimko 2015 Table 1: male clone 50.6 +- 11.2, female 54.6 +- 9.0 mm [M]; the photo shows only its top

diameter_top_mm.source: this photo, the petiole's width below the junction at the assumed scale [M/A]

diameter_base_mm.source: the swollen end at the twig [A]

overlap_mm.source: the tube's top end runs this far into the blade's base [A]
